concepts.title: The Little Father Mythos: The Sacral-Somatic Bond

concepts.title: The Tsar's Shield Myth
concepts.excerpt: The Tsar's Shield Myth refers to the foundational autocratic belief that the Russian Emperor was the "Little Father" (Batyushka), a mystical protector of the peasantry whose divine legitimacy shielded the nation from both external enemies and internal corruption.
